title.rendered: (Update) Chase Sapphire & Freedom Cards Get 10x With Paze Checkout through 2026 (United, Shoprite, Dunkin, Etc.)

content.rendered:
Update 10/25/26: I’m not sure if this is new or old, but I just bumped into this today – it seems some United cards also have an offer for 10x bonus United miles per dollar on Paze checkout through December 31st. The limit on United card is 20,000 miles total, different than the 15,000/month limit on Freedom and Sapphire cards. Offer is also going out now via email, it might be targeted. (ht BWMM)

Update 6/21/26: Some people are seeing Giftcards.com with Paze checkout on mobile. It should work for the 10x promo with Chase cards. Some suggest that since Giftcards.com is a giftcard merchant it would be excluded, per the terms. (It’s not showing the $10 off banner, so might not be eligible for that promo.) Update: apparently giftcards.com has not been earning 10x, for some reason.

Update 6/16/26: Chase has excluded Newegg from the 10x promo from June 30, 2026 and onward.
